notes.title: Office After Hours - Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
A message to all those working at Endless Solutions


It's now been just over two weeks since the release. I would like to thank everyone who has played Office After Hours!!!❤️️

The game has been very well received, which means a lot to me as it is my first commercial game.  



As a thank you, I added an extra secret to the game🤫

The key is to look for it at the very end. 


Bugs and fixes
Fixed an issue where leaving the computer caused buggy behavior. 

Fixed an issue when replaying the fire anomaly🚒

Fixed a bug where the visuals of the third hell item remained after death. 

Some minor additions have been made to improve player guidance.  


Bonus news: 
I've teamed up with some other devs to release a steam bundle!

Every game in this bundle offers a unique experience within the anomaly genre.

Take a look if you like this type of games.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54587/Anomaly_Games_Collection/"][/dynamiclink]

Thanks again and see you in the next shift,

YoghurtDrop

notes.title: Mandatory Overtime: The Office After Hours Demo Update
notes.notes:
Attention Slackers.

The Office After Hours demo has been updated, and I expect you to keep up. Productivity is everything, and I’ve made sure you have no excuses for underperformance. Here’s what’s new:

🔥 Overwork Hell – Phase 1 out of 3
Welcome to the first glimpse of what happens when you really push past your limits. Clock in and find out.

👀 Better Introduction
Too many of you were wandering around clueless. That’s unacceptable. Now, you’ll get a clearer start—so you can fail more efficiently.

🛠 Visual Enhancements
The office has had adjustments. Maybe you’ll actually notice them this time.

💀 Different Anomalies
Things are changing again. Keep up.

📢 Improved Feedback
No more “I didn’t know that was wrong!” Now you’ll know exactly when you’ve messed up. That means fewer excuses.

Clock in. Play the demo. And don’t disappoint me.

Final Notice
Do not forget to wishlist the game or leave a review on my desk ;)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I’m excited to share some development updates about Office After Hours. Over the past weeks, I’ve been hard at work bringing new features and experiences to life, all aimed at making the game even more engaging and unique. Here’s a sneak peek into what’s coming your way:

1. New Anomalies for a Unique Experience
I’m introducing new office-related anomalies that delve into the problems and suffering that can arise in a competitive office environment. These anomalies are designed to reflect the pressures of overwork, unrealistic deadlines, and office politics, immersing you in the emotional weight of these experiences.

2. Expanding the Game’s Environments
New environments are created to immerse you in the unsettling world of Office After Hours and show you the disturbing story behind the office.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/db6ea10284d6dd05f1ff8de9cb572c3869d9ad46.png

3. Story Almost Complete
The game’s story is nearly finished. The narrative lets you delve into the dark side of overwork and corporate pressure, guiding you through new environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/b412bf0850285e776442f39bd18a428b62918e95.png

4. Cutscenes for Immersion
To make the game even more immersive, I’ve added cutscenes that bring key moments to life. These cinematic additions will deepen the story and help you connect with the game’s characters and world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/ec122b827f592bb8e44e616aff70826c1db6ce54.gif

5. In-Game Death Mechanics
You can now face life-or-death stakes in Office After Hours! With the addition of a death mechanic, your decisions and actions will have greater consequences, adding to the tension and challenge.

6. New Functions and Features
I have added a zoom function so that even small details can be recognised.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45251005/a0a321555a6be630250869c53595753ebd536d9f.gif


Stay tuned for more updates as I continue refining Office After Hours. The current demo gives a glimpse of the game, but it’s now a bit out of date compared to what the final experience will offer. I’m considering updating the demo to reflect these exciting changes.

Thank you for being part of this journey.

YoghurtDrop

notes.title: Demo update v0.9.2
notes.notes:
Here's a quick look at what’s new:

 Controller support and SteamDeck compatibility
 Creepier anomalies

Thank you to everyone who joined during Steam Next Fest, played the demo, and wishlisted the game. Your support and feedback have been very helpful in improving the game.

In this update, I'm excited to share that Xbox controller support has been added! SteamDeck compatibility has been tested but still needs to be verified, making it easier for those of you who prefer to play without a keyboard and mouse.

You wanted the anomalies be creepier so I improved some of them. Things might get a little more chilling after hours.

I'm also working on some small improvements and bug fixes for the next update, and adding one more anomaly for Halloween to keep things extra spooky.

Additionally, I’m still eager to hear your thoughts! Your feedback through the Community Hub or the feedback form is incredibly helpful. I’ve received some really kind words through the feedback form that made my day.

One more thing—what’s the creepiest thing you could imagine happening in an office after hours? Let me know.

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Demo update v0.9.0
notes.notes:
First of all thanks to everyone who played the demo and wishlisted! 
Also huge thanks to the people that send me feedback. It really helps to improve the game.

This update comes with a performance boost. I had to rework a lot of the core logic because I use a lot more baked lighting now. This also comes with a visual upgrade.

From your feedback I can see that some of the anomalies were too difficult to find and also some clearer instructions would be helpful. So I have also made some small changes:

 Better instructions at the beginning of the game
 A difficult anomaly can now appear later.
 Some difficult anomalies become easier to find after you have missed them.

You also want creepier anomalies. Don't worry, they will come.

Before that, I will be working on controller support and SteamDeck compatibility, which will probably not take much time as I already have things set up.

Please continue with the feedback in the Community Hub or via the feedback form so I can give you the best game experience.

By the way, what are you most afraid of in an office? Let me know.

Thanks for your support!
